fullPassage: Dennis William Sciama was born in Manchester, England, in 1926. He received an education in mathematics and physics at Malvern College. Despite his father's wish for him to take over the family business, Sciama chose to continue pursuing his academic career. After earning a doctoral degree in physics from the University of Cambridge in 1953, he became famous for his research on the universe. Early in his career, Sciama supported the steady-state theory, which argued that the universe had no beginning. However, when new evidence against the theory appeared in the 1960s, he changed his view and accepted the Big Bang model. In 1991, he was awarded the Guthrie Medal for outstanding contributions to experimental physics by the British Institute of Physics. Sciama's role as a mentor became known even outside academic circles. Later, he was introduced in films about his most famous student, Stephen Hawking, which made Sciama known to a wider audience.

questions.passage: Dennis William Sciama was born in Manchester, England, in 1926. He received an (A)[education / vacation] in mathematics and physics at Malvern College. Despite his father's wish for him to take over the family business, Sciama chose to continue (B)[pursuing / abandoning] his academic career. After earning a (C)[doctoral / bachelor's] degree in physics from the University of Cambridge in 1953, he became famous for his research on the universe.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Sciama는 수학과 물리학 교육(education)을 받았고, 학문적 경력을 추구(pursuing)하기로 했으며, 박사(doctoral) 학위를 취득했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① education — pursuing — doctoral: 원문과 일치
❌ ② vacation(휴가): education의 반의어적 맥락
❌ ③ abandoning(포기하는): pursuing의 반의어
❌ ④ bachelor's(학사): 원문은 doctoral(박사)
det.tip: pursue = 추구하다, doctoral degree = 박사 학위, education = 교육

questions.passage: Early in his career, Sciama (A)[supported / opposed] the steady-state theory, which argued that the universe had no beginning. However, when new (B)[evidence / rumor] against the theory appeared in the 1960s, he changed his view and (C)[accepted / rejected] the Big Bang model.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Sciama는 정상상태 이론을 지지(supported)했지만, 새 증거(evidence)가 나타나자 빅뱅 모델을 수용(accepted)했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ supported — evidence — accepted: 원문과 일치
❌ ① opposed(반대했다): 처음에 지지했으므로 부적절
❌ ② rumor(소문): evidence가 정확
❌ ④ rejected(거부했다): 수용한 것이므로 부적절
det.tip: support = 지지하다, evidence = 증거, accept = 수용하다/받아들이다
